reference_sql:
WITH w AS (
  -- one row per paid channel and month
  SELECT channel_id, month, budget_eur,
    AVG(budget_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_3m,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS months_in_window
  FROM budget_monthly
)
SELECT channel_id, month, budget_eur,
  CASE WHEN months_in_window = 3 THEN ROUND(avg_3m, 2) END AS avg_budget_3m
FROM w
WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-12-01'
alternatives:
WITH w AS (
  -- one row per paid channel and month
  SELECT channel_id, month, budget_eur,
    LAG(budget_eur, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY month) AS prev_1,
    LAG(budget_eur, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY month) AS prev_2
  FROM budget_monthly
)
SELECT channel_id, month, budget_eur, ROUND((budget_eur + prev_1 + prev_2) / 3, 2) AS avg_budget_3m
FROM w
WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-12-01'

SELECT m.channel_id, m.month, m.budget_eur,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 3 THEN ROUND(AVG(p.budget_eur), 2) END AS avg_budget_3m
FROM budget_monthly m
JOIN budget_monthly p ON p.channel_id = m.channel_id AND p.month BETWEEN m.month - INTERVAL 2 MONTH AND m.month
WHERE m.month BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-12-01'
GROUP BY m.channel_id, m.month, m.budget_eur

SELECT channel_id, month, budget_eur, ROUND((budget_eur + prev_1 + prev_2) / 3, 2) AS avg_budget_3m

other_way.tradeoff: Two LAGs bring the 2 earlier budgets onto each row and leave a short window missing by themselves, but a longer window needs more LAGs.

solver.query:
WITH w AS (
  SELECT channel_id, month, budget_eur,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS n,
    AVG(budget_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg3
  FROM budget_monthly
)
SELECT channel_id, month, budget_eur,
  CASE WHEN n = 3 THEN ROUND(avg3, 2) END AS avg_budget_3m
FROM w
WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-12-01'
